source_mechanisms_r4: FREEZE-WITH-LIVE-TIMER (owner symptom 3) — mechanism confirmed at source level on the LIVE build: game.js _loop reschedules requestAnimationFrame BEFORE updating (live game.js: _loop rAF-first, same as main game.js:179), and the 'fight' branch of _update decrements the timer + ui.setTimer FIRST (live game.js ~196-199), then runs input/AI, then fighter updates. A deterministic throw anywhere in the input/fighter section therefore leaves: loop alive, timer counting, fighters frozen, inputs dead — the owner's exact description. Unguarded reads of this class existed on live: live game.js:230-231 reads this.p1.char.surge.color/.name with no guard inside the surge action handler (main fixed this class in PR #471 B5: 'guard char.surge.* reads in game.js'). The T3 NaN defect is a SECOND freeze-class mechanism, main-only pre-#469 (live t3anims.js is the old direct-bind build without retargetClipToRig).

INTRO GATE: round start sets roundState='intro', input disabled, and flips to 'fight' via setTimeout(1100ms) (main game.js ~166-173; live equivalent ~155-160). Timer does NOT run during intro — so a match stuck in intro shows a FROZEN timer, distinguishable from symptom 3. Owner's timer ran => his freeze state was roundState='fight' with a dead update path, not a stuck intro.

SINKING (owner symptom 4) — LIVE build: assets.js contains NO groundY/grounding code at all (grep groundY = 0 hits on live assets.js). Hip-origin GLBs therefore stand waist-deep by construction. Main added a measured correction 2026-10-20 (assets.js:589 groundY{} + 644-660 measure lowest skinned-vertex world Y at load + 747-748 createInstance lifts inner.position.y=-gy when |gy|>0.03) — AFTER the Oct-20 20:16Z live deploy cut, so the owner never had it. Main's own comment names the affected models: 'star / torch / michiko / diablo: vertices span y -1.05..0.8, so they stood waist-deep in the floor' — matches Rig Studio's Star min-y -1.0502 measurement and the owner's 'falling halfway through the ground... was not happening before' (regression window = when those models/attires shipped). RESIDUAL RISKS on main (source-level, untested in-browser): groundY is keyed by fighter id only, not per-attire; unskinned/static GLBs (samura1 class) measure y0=Infinity -> groundY=0 -> no lift; measurement happens once per id at first load.

SLIDING (owner symptom 1) — source candidates on main fighter.js: (a) _physics (fighter.js:1000-1005): vx decays (x0.0001^dt) ONLY when onGround AND state not in {walk, dodge, sidestep, grab-attack}; a fighter latched in 'walk' state keeps vx (state machine fighter.js ~994: state = |vx|>0.4 ? 'walk':'idle' — self-sustaining if vx is re-set each tick); (b) tryMove (fighter.js:591) sets vx = dir*stats.speed from input axisX every tick — a stuck/non-zero axisX (touch joystick never zeroed on release in input.js) walks forever; (c) PR #471 B4 ('clear attack/attackName when leaving attack state', stuck-aura fix) shows the latched-state family was live. In-browser confirmation blocked (see environment note).

SELECT PERSISTENCE (owner symptom 2) — main.js show(name) (main.js:43-55) removes .active from ALL screens then activates one; startFight calls show('hud') (main.js ~660). Select previews are PreviewPane instances with their OWN scenes/renderers (select-screen.js:49-93, canvases #pane-canvas-p1/p2 inside #screen-select), NOT the arena scene — so a center-screen T-posed model during a fight is NOT explained by preview-scene bleed IF show() ran. Alternative source candidates: (a) a fighter instance spawned at arena center (x=0) that never got positioned/animated — e.g. startFight's enemy resolution randomEnemy fallback or a transform/forms preload instance; (b) the parallel WH UI (main.js:688 mountWhUi when whUiEnabled()) manages screens separately from show() — two screen managers can disagree about #screen-select visibility. In-browser DOM confirmation blocked; the one clean partial run showed selectActive=True only while on select (correct), and arena children at select = ['Group:stage-shrine'] only.
SAMURA1 / IORI side cases: not reached in-browser this session. Source note: assets.js grounding traverse only counts SkinnedMesh — an unskinned model gets groundY=0 (see sinking risks).
